items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and retain only existing reversible evidence or remediation work. Revenue is supported only for 2026-09-21: $4.92 Amazon commission on 28 ordered items and 6 shipped items, but all $4.92 is in an aggregate unattributed row. AI spend is $901.897533 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs are not recorded in matching periods. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, and cost-to-learn are therefore not calculable. Do not approve new spend, monetization changes, deployments, requeues, experiments, telemetry, or unsupported revenue claims. Retain the existing period-aligned reconciliation and bounded site remediation only.

Minimum finance evidence still missing: matching-period infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment, and other operating costs; approved budget ceilings; and an owner-approved cost-to-learn threshold. Until those records exist, report revenue as $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission and AI spend as $901.897533, with no contribution-margin or cost-to-learn conclusion.
